learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to level up your game by learning how to throw with laser accuracy and catch the ball smoothly while running like a pro athlete!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Keep your eyes locked on the target! Step forward with your opposite foot and point your non-throwing arm straight at where you want the ball to go.
Do not just stand still, move your feet to where the ball is flying! Keep your hands ready like a big soft basket and watch the ball all the way into your palms.
Passing quickly is the secret to winning games! Call out your teammate's name, make eye contact, and throw smooth, fast passes to outsmart the other team.
Always stay alert on the field and never throw a ball when your friend is not looking. Great athletes play by the rules and keep everyone safe during the game!

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Moving Hoop Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Ask a parent or friend to hold a hula hoop or a big cushion and slowly walk around the yard. Try to throw a soft ball right through the hoop while they are moving!

quick_recap: ⭐ Always look directly at your target and step forward before throwing with power!
⭐ Make a basket shape with your hands and hug the ball into your chest after catching.
⭐ Moving quickly and safely passing to your teammates makes you a true sports champion!
